options_evaluated: Recycled post-consumer PC/ABS blend with monomaterial structure
Bio-based polyamide (PA6) with glass fiber reinforcement
Virgin ABS with overmolded TPE grip
assessments.recommendation: Recycled post-consumer PC/ABS blend with monomaterial structure
assessments.rationale: Using post-consumer recycled (PCR) PC/ABS directly supports parameter (h) by maximizing recycled content. Designing a monomaterial structure without overmolded TPE elastomer ensures high-quality sorting and purification during end-of-life processing, satisfying parameter (d). This design also minimizes the consumption of virgin fossil-based resources, reducing the overall material footprint (o).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Phase (ergonomics and grip comfort may be reduced without a soft TPE overmold) and Manufacturing (PCR resins have higher viscosity and narrower processing windows than virgin plastics, increasing molding complexity).

options_evaluated: Threaded fasteners (screws) directly into plastic bosses
assessments.recommendation: Threaded fasteners (screws) directly into plastic bosses
assessments.rationale: Threaded fasteners allow non-destructive disassembly of the housing, which is critical for parameter (d) design for recycling and parameter (k) the incorporation of used components (such as reclaiming the motor or gearset). Unlike ultrasonic welding or adhesives, screws do not introduce foreign materials or permanently fuse parts, preserving the material footprint (o).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased assembly cycle time and higher bill of materials count compared to rapid ultrasonic welding) and User Phase (screws can back out under tool vibration, potentially reducing structural integrity over time).

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets
Brushless DC motor with neodymium (rare-earth) magnets
Coreless DC motor with precious metal brushes
assessments.recommendation: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets
assessments.rationale: Ferrite magnets avoid the use of critical raw materials like neodymium and dysprosium, aligning with parameter (f) by avoiding substances of concern/critical materials and parameter (o) by reducing the material footprint. Additionally, brushed motors are highly standardized, facilitating parameter (k) the incorporation of used or remanufactured motors in future product cycles.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Phase (brushed motors have lower energy efficiency, shorter service life due to brush wear, and lower power-to-weight ratio compared to brushless alternatives).

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via housing ventilation slots and a recycled aluminum heatsink
Active cooling via an integrated plastic rotor fan
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via housing ventilation slots and a recycled aluminum heatsink
assessments.rationale: This approach satisfies parameter (t) lightweight design and parameter (j) by minimizing the volume and weight of active cooling components. Utilizing recycled aluminum supports parameter (h) recycled content, while avoiding complex PCM chemicals lowers the environmental footprint (m) and avoids potential substances of concern (f).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Phase (ventilation slots increase the risk of dust and moisture ingress into the motor, potentially shortening the tool's operating life in harsh environments).

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with plug-and-play modules (battery, switch, motor, gearbox)
Fully integrated single-board design with soldered connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with plug-and-play modules (battery, switch, motor, gearbox)
assessments.rationale: A modular architecture enables easy separation of distinct material streams (electronics, copper-rich motors, steel gears), directly supporting parameter (d) design for recycling. It facilitates parameter (k) the incorporation of used components by allowing individual modules to be harvested, tested, and reused, thereby reducing the overall material footprint (o).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased complexity of internal routing and connector assembly) and lightweight design / parameter (j) (the extra connectors, housing walls, and wires increase the weight and volume of the tool).

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized cylindrical cell battery pack (screw-fastened)
Integrated pouch lithium-ion battery pack (soldered and glued)
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized cylindrical cell battery pack (screw-fastened)
assessments.rationale: A removable, screw-fastened battery pack avoids gluing and potting, which directly supports parameter (d) design for recycling. It allows the battery cells to be replaced or harvested, facilitating parameter (k) incorporation of used components and significantly reducing the lifecycle environmental footprint (m) by preventing premature tool disposal when only the battery degrades.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Phase (a removable battery pack increases the physical size and weight of the screwdriver, potentially conflicting with parameter (j) weight and volume and parameter (t) lightweight design compared to an integrated pouch cell).
